## CLI: python -m scanplan.cli <command> …

- info scan.e57
- plan scan.e57 out.png \[–cut 1.2\] \[–px 0.005\] \[–style hybrid\]
  \[–look up\] \[–scale 50\]
- section scan.e57 out.png –a x,y –b x,y \[–side right\] \[–depth 1.0\]
  \[–px 0.005\]
- elev scan.e57 out.png –a x,y –b x,y \[–side right\]

Writes <out>.png plus <out>.pgw (world file) and <out>.json (metadata).
